subject: Install gcc14 static libstdc++ for benchmark builds due to #1360 (#1383)
reason: The change edits only ci/install_deps.sh, installing the gcc14-libstdc++-static package and asserting that libstdc++.a exists so CI benchmark builds can link statically. It is purely a build/CI infrastructure change with no modification to module code, commands, replies, persistence, or replication, so no runtime behavior changed and no fuzzer scenario can exercise it.
